description: Hand-labelled risks from both valid meeting transcripts.

risks.description: Third-party payment API (Meridian Pay) has been unreliable with intermittent timeouts and outages, potentially causing the team to miss the integration deadline for the payments module
risks.verbatim_quote: The third-party payment API from Meridian Pay has been unreliable over the past two weeks. We've seen intermittent timeouts and two complete outages. If this continues we might miss the integration deadline for the payments module
risks.speaker: Sarah Chen

risks.description: Compliance audit is scheduled for October 15th and the encryption module may not be complete by then, which would require postponement and delay go-live by at least a month
risks.verbatim_quote: Our compliance audit is scheduled for October fifteenth and the auditors will want to see the encryption module fully operational by then. If the encryption module isn't complete, we'll need to request a postponement which would delay our go-live by at least a month
risks.speaker: David Park

risks.description: Booking.com and Expedia publish no public rate APIs, so the smart pricing feature depends on a paid channel manager API or on legally grey scraping
risks.verbatim_quote: Booking.com and Expedia don't have public APIs for rate data. We'd need to either use a channel manager API like SiteMinder or build scrapers, which is legally grey
risks.speaker: Haritha

risks.description: Four AI features on top of six core modules, built evenings and weekends, is a large scope for the stated six-week Phase 1
risks.verbatim_quote: That's four AI features plus six core modules. That's a massive scope. We need to be realistic about what we can ship first
risks.speaker: Haritha
